name: Steamed Hams - An Unforgettable Luncheon
source:
Steamed Hams is an adaptation of the 22 Short Films About Springfield skit of the same name; this adaptation was made as part of a game jam, where the goal was to learn Ren'Py and create an experience in 8 hours.

This experience needed to incorporate the genre of visual novel and theme of sacrfices must be made. This project was completed in the scope of 8 hours, enjoy.
translation:
《Steamed Hams》改編自《辛普森家庭》「春田市的22個短篇故事」中同名的橋段。本作是一次遊戲創作活動的作品，目標是在8小時內學習Ren'Py並製作一段遊戲體驗。

本作需要採用視覺小說形式，並以「必須有所犧牲」為主題。專案在8小時內完成，祝你遊玩愉快。
